title: Email and CRM provider
lede: A business run by agents needs email, a contact database and a sales pipeline from day one, and the email/CRM provider's API covers nearly three hundred operations. I rebuilt every one of them as a tool of my own behind my gateway. Around them I built the path: identity checks on every caller, the work order worked out from that identity, a durable record of every call, and inbound events routed back to the right team. The provider's credentials never leave my server. This provider does not support stamping work-order tags onto what it creates, so the gateway attributes its calls in its own accounting and leaves the provider's objects untouched. Loyalty programs, 50 tools.
evidence: Governed API integration for AI agents: 291 tools rebuilt from an email and CRM provider's API, letting agent teams run campaigns, transactional messages, contacts, deals and loyalty programs.
Credential isolation and attribution: provider credentials never leave my server, every call is recorded and attributed in my own accounting, and inbound events reach the team that caused them.
author: Corey James
